purpose: Create standalone JavaScript/Python code projects from explicit typed programs and acceptance contracts through six deterministic professional procedures.

properties.path: New ordinary project directory; existing projects and machine internals are protected.
properties.request: Code workflow request: action build, verify or retain plus explicit job. Verify/retain explicitly execute freshly generated bounded code.

relationships: Consumes bundled Grammar 102 compiler and Profession Fabric procedures; writes through the existing project boundary.
limitations: 48 closed expression operations; JavaScript and Python only; not arbitrary application synthesis or source translation.
Build mode creates candidates without execution; verify/retain require Node and Python with bounded process execution, not an OS sandbox.
Verification covers declared cases, repeated observations and requested-language parity; not full specification, branch coverage, deployment or security.
Retention is explicit, additive project data. No silent canon promotion or shared machine mutation.
